source_owner: Ministry of Culture Sports and Tourism / Korea Culture and Tourism Institute
definition: Official same-year task specification defines the survey target as foreigners from 20 named-country groups plus Other who depart after visiting Korea.
methodology: same-year official procurement/task specification for 2025 fieldwork
limitations: Procurement specification verifies planned scope, not realized respondent counts or final raw-code implementation. Exact 20-country labels/codes must be extracted from final codebook/raw artifacts before harmonization.

source_owner: Ministry of Culture Sports and Tourism / Korea Culture and Tourism Institute
definition: Official task specification requires at least 16,000 respondents, approximately 1,333 per month.
limitations: This is planned sample size, not realized sample. Do not substitute for final annual/monthly achieved counts.

source_owner: Ministry of Culture Sports and Tourism / Korea Culture and Tourism Institute
definition: The 2025 request for proposals states that foreigners departing after visiting Korea form the population and that monthly sample allocation should account for nationality, sex, entry point and age composition of foreign tourists.
limitations: This source does not provide the final allocation formula, realized cells, raw weight variable, calibration procedure, nonresponse adjustment or PSU/stratum identifiers. Those remain UNKNOWN pending final sample-design/codebook extraction.

source_owner: Ministry of Culture Sports and Tourism / Korea Culture and Tourism Institute
definition: Official 2025 RFP requires survey forms in 14 languages: English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), French, German, Russian, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Filipino, Mongolian, Arabic and Malaysian.
limitations: This verifies planned language coverage only. It does not prove respondent-level language used, final translated questionnaire equivalence, or publication of all language versions. The official source's 14-language description is preserved without reinterpreting how Chinese variants are counted.

source_owner: Ministry of Culture Sports and Tourism / Korea Culture and Tourism Institute
source_title: 2024 and 2025 Foreign Tourist Survey official procurement specifications
definition: The 2024 official specification describes a 12-language set ending with Mongolian, while the 2025 official RFP describes a 14-language set that additionally includes Arabic and Malaysian.
methodology: direct comparison of same-owner official annual procurement specifications
limitations: This is a verified planned-design difference, not proof that questionnaire wording or measurement changed. No longitudinal response effect is inferred. Final 2025 questionnaire publication remains unverified on the current official questionnaire registry.

source_owner: Ministry of Culture Sports and Tourism / Korea Culture and Tourism Institute
definition: The official task specification requires delivery of final report, collected and processed raw data, codebook, user guide, analysis command files and related information, fieldwork report, fieldwork manual, data-editing report including nonresponse imputation, sample-design report including weights, reliability report, and respondent incentive records.
limitations: Required delivery to the commissioning body does not establish public publication or current public accessibility. In particular, user guide, editing report, sample-design report, reliability report and analysis syntax must remain NOT_PUBLICLY_VERIFIED/UNKNOWN until an official public artifact is located.

source_owner: Korea Tourism Organization / Korea Culture and Tourism Institute
definition: Official Korea Tourism Data Lab page publicly lists 2025 raw data ZIP and 2025 codebook XLSX; the page is dated 2026-06-04 and attributes the source to Korea Culture and Tourism Institute.
limitations: Artifact listing confirms availability but does not by itself extract field definitions or respondent rows. Public page states Public Nuri Type 4 conditions; exact license applicability to downloaded raw/codebook should be preserved according to the page and file notices.
license: Public Nuri Type 4 shown on official page

definition: Current official questionnaire registry lists annual questionnaire artifacts through 2024 and does not list a 2025 questionnaire entry.
limitations: Absence from the current registry is not evidence that no 2025 questionnaire existed or was delivered internally. Preserve public questionnaire status as UNKNOWN/NOT_VERIFIED rather than NOT_PUBLISHED_BY_DESIGN.
